observations: Photo 0: stacked used tires outdoors, many with spray-paint marks (size/price codes) on sidewalls, visible wear and dirt, no clear brand lettering legible.
Photo 1: more stacked used tires, wheel rims hanging in background, tread visible but worn, no size or brand markings readable.
Photo 2: similar stacked tires with spray paint, a car and shop stalls in background, no close-up of any sidewall text, DOT code, or tread depth gauge.
All three photos show a roadside tire market scene, not a single specific tire being sold; no size, brand, or manufacture date is legible in any shot.

claims.evidence: No sidewall brand, size, or DOT/manufacture code is legible in any of the three photos; 'Belgium' and 'first grade' are market terms used locally for used European tires and cannot be confirmed from images.

response.reason: Photos confirm this is generic used/tokunbo tire stock at a roadside market with no verifiable brand, size, or grade; 'first grade' and 'Belgium' claims are unverifiable from images, so it is priced at worst case as ordinary used tire stock comparable to similar unverified listings.
